text:
maya: Quick heads-up — getting an alert flood from scanner-heartbeat. Lots of workers failing to decrypt cache keys after the KMS rotation. sample logs below.

chris: @maya ping me, I can help triage. any runbook link? :eyes: 

maya: runbook: https://internal/runbooks/scanner-kms-decrypt. My theory: retry loop + no jitter => duplicate work and queue thrash.

sam: saw similar last month when IAM token TTL didn't propagate across clusters.

maya: logs: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z worker-7 ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z worker-7 INFO retrying in 1s
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z worker-8 ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z orchestrator WARN scheduling duplicate scan for commit abc123
```

jess: is Trivy or GHAS touching the KMS? AFAIK KMS is used to unwrap private-registry creds and to decrypt suppression DB keys.

chris: suppression-sync writes use KMS. If decrypt fails the worker marks task unfinished -> requeue -> tight retry window -> mass requeues.

maya: what changed? I rotated the KMS key role yesterday for compliance. I updated the IAM trust but might have missed one cluster annotation.

sam: can confirm cluster-c still has the old service-account annotation.

devops-bot: deploy event: restarted deployment/scanner-zone-b at 2026-03-20T14:03:05Z (triggered by maya)

maya: Mitigation plan: restarting affected pods + push quick RBAC patch to cluster annotations to point to new service-account mapping. Also temporarily increase retry backoff to avoid flood.

chris: +1. Also enable "dedupe-on-run-id" in the orchestrator (config flip) to avoid duplicate scans on transient failures.

jess: Can we patch suppression-sync to tolerate decrypt timeouts for 30s and then surface an incident? That should cut the noise.

maya: opening a ticket and will spin up a short incident channel if we need escalation.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0456 scanner-kms-decrypt-flood. Priority: P2. Assignees: maya, chris.

sam: after restart, cluster-c pods still throwing AccessDenied. looks like nodepool-autoscaler-sa missing from rolebinding.

maya: adding nodepool-autoscaler-sa to rolebinding now. Also bumping KMS retry to exponential backoff with jitter, cap 60s.

chris: can we add a Prometheus alert: "scan_retry_rate > 5/min AND decrypt_errors > 0" with a 15m cooldown? That should avoid pager storms but keep visibility.

maya: yes, will add alert w/ 15m cooldown and slack notify to #eng-security-incidents.

jess: longer term: add a CI preflight test that validates KMS decrypt after rollout and a lint check for service-account annotations on cluster manifests.

maya: agreed. PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scanner/pull/1128

sam: any Snyk/Trivy jobs impacted? I think only suppression DB and private-registry pulls use KMS. Public-image scans should be fine.

chris: GHAS workflows probably unaffected, but central orchestrator triggers wrapper which touches suppression DB so watch for orphaned runs.

maya: status update: RBAC patch applied to clusters A,B,C. decrypt errors down ~95%. Keeping P2 incident open for follow-ups (postmortem + runbook updates).

jess: nice. Please include a note about rotating service accounts and a checklist for KMS role updates.

maya: will write a short postmortem and update runbook.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 updated: status=monitoring, last_update=2026-03-20T14:12:30Z

chris: thanks team :thumbsup:
